description.value: BC Liquor Store is a provincial government-operated alcohol retail chain with 198 locations across British Columbia, selling wine, beer, spirits, coolers, and ciders. The chain serves over 36 million retail customers annually and is operated by the BC Liquor Distribution Branch. A touring cyclist stopping here could pick up beer or wine, but the store is primarily an alcohol retailer rather than a rest stop or hospitality venue.
